title: Mass Cytometry Workflow for High-Dimensional Immunophenotyping
author: Smith, Cohen, et al.
materials: Pierce Universal Nuclease for Cell Lysis

steps.title: Remove plasma from whole blood
steps.instruction: Centrifuge whole blood (WB) and carefully aspirate the plasma layer, discarding the plasma.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs from blood
steps.instruction: Perform density‑gradient centrifugation on the plasma‑depleted blood to isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs).

steps.title: Stain 3 × 10⁶ PBMCs with CyTOF antibodies
steps.instruction: Aliquot exactly three million PBMCs, add the lyophilized CyTOF antibody cocktail, and incubate according to the antibody manufacturer’s recommended time and temperature for surface staining.

steps.title: Cryopreserve stained and unstained PBMCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend both the stained PBMCs and any additional unstained PBMCs in appropriate cryopreservation medium, place in cryovials, and store at –80 °C (or in liquid nitrogen) until shipment.

steps.title: Thaw and count PBMCs at central site
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw frozen PBMC vials in a 37 °C water bath, dilute in warm complete medium, centrifuge to remove DMSO, resuspend, and count viable cells using a hemocytometer or automated counter.

steps.title: Remove plasma from whole blood (WB protocol)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge fresh whole blood and aspirate the plasma layer, discarding the plasma.

steps.title: Add 500 µL plasma‑depleted WB to antibodies
steps.instruction: Transfer exactly 500 µL of the plasma‑depleted whole blood directly into a tube containing the lyophilized CyTOF antibody cocktail and mix gently.

steps.title: Cryopreserve stained whole blood without washes
steps.instruction: Immediately place the stained whole‑blood mixture into cryovials with cryopreservation medium and store at –80 °C (or in liquid nitrogen) without performing any wash steps.

steps.title: Thaw whole blood batches at central lab
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen whole‑blood samples in a 37 °C water bath, process in batches as needed for downstream steps.

steps.title: Deplete neutrophils using magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Incubate thawed whole‑blood cells with neutrophil‑depletion magnetic beads according to the bead manufacturer’s protocol, then separate neutrophil‑depleted cells using a magnetic separator.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Treat the stained PBMCs or neutrophil‑depleted whole‑blood cells with a fixation solution, then add a permeabilization buffer to allow intracellular antibody access.

steps.title: Barcode and multiplex cells
steps.instruction: Apply the appropriate metal‑based barcode reagents to each sample, incubate as directed, then combine (multiplex) the barcoded samples into a single tube.

steps.title: Stain cells for surface antigens
steps.instruction: Incubate the barcoded cell mixture with the surface‑antigen CyTOF antibody panel under the recommended conditions.

steps.title: Stain cells for DNA content
steps.instruction: Add a DNA intercalator reagent to the cells and incubate to label DNA for later identification of singlets.

steps.title: Acquire data within 48 h or cryopreserve
steps.instruction: Either run the prepared samples on the CyTOF instrument within 48 hours of staining, or cryopreserve them for long‑term storage before later acquisition.
